grain: one focal player-game in a selected source Opening family
filters: completed non-marked-bot games; exact color, half-open player rating band, exact base+increment, two named source opening families; recorded opponent rating required for adjustment
score: wins plus 0.5 times draws divided by eligible player-games
strata: player rating minus recorded opponent rating: below -100, -100 to 99, and 100 or more
common_weights: pooled eligible player-game counts over strata represented in both openings, normalized to sum to one
adjusted_result: within-stratum score rates for each opening averaged using identical common weights
interval: 400 seeded focal-player cluster bootstrap repetitions within each opening; percentile 2.5 and 97.5 bounds among valid resamples
low_support: fewer than 100 eligible player-games is a project warning
null_rules: missing opponent rating is excluded from adjustment but remains in raw score; a missing common stratum yields no adjusted rate
caveats: Observed ordered prefix only; no month-wide inference.
Bootstrap does not model opponent dependence or archive-prefix selection.
